declarations.name: SPREADSHEET_COLORS
declarations.description: The named colours a cell's text or background can take. Each is a CSS variable, so themes and dark mode recolour them.

A small editable grid with basic formulas: budgets, quotes, price lists, score sheets. One sheet, about twenty
functions, keyboard editing that works like Sheets and Excel, and copy and paste with both. It is not a
spreadsheet application: there is no cell styling, no second sheet and no file import.

`data` holds the raw inputs row by row. A string starting with `=` is a formula (`=SUM(D1:D5)`); a leading `'`
keeps the rest as text. Typing `10%` or `$12` keeps that look in the cell. Formulas support `+ - * / ^ &`,
comparisons, `%`, `A1` references and `A1:B5` ranges, and the functions `SUM`, `AVERAGE`, `MIN`, `MAX`, `COUNT`,
`COUNTA`, `ROUND`, `ABS`, `IF`, `IFERROR`, `AND`, `OR`, `NOT`, `SUMIF`, `CONCAT`, `LEN`, `UPPER`, `LOWER`,
`TRIM` and `TODAY`. Add your own through `functions`. Errors show in the cell (`#DIV/0!`, `#REF!`, `#NAME?`,
`#VALUE!`, `#NUM!`, `#CIRC!`, `#ERROR!`) with the reason in a tooltip.

Typing a formula is guided: after `=`, or on a name, a list offers the functions with what they take and do (↑↓
chooses, Tab or Enter inserts `SUM(`); inside a call, a hint names its arguments with the current one in bold, and
the result shows before Enter. Where a reference can go, clicking a cell puts it in the formula and dragging makes a
range. A formula left open is closed on Enter. The formula bar's fx button lists every function.

The totals bar (`summary`) adds up the selection; each total is a button that writes its formula under the range
(`=SUM(C1:C4)` in C5), as `insertTotal()` does.

Keyboard: arrows move, Shift+arrows extend the range, typing replaces the cell, Enter, F2 or a double-click edit
it, Enter and Tab commit and move, Escape cancels, Delete clears, Ctrl/⌘+C, X, V copy, cut and paste as
tab-separated text, Ctrl/⌘+Z and Y undo and redo, Ctrl/⌘+A selects every cell. Tab outside an edit leaves the grid.

A paste larger than the space left grows the sheet to fit. `insertRows`, `insertColumns`, `deleteRows` and
`deleteColumns` change the sheet's shape, and formulas keep pointing at the cells they read.

Wrapped in a `c2-context-menu`, a right-clicked cell, row header or column header selects itself (unless it is
already selected) and answers the menu's request with a `SpreadsheetContextMenuData` (`area`, `range`, `active`,
`start`, `end`), which `renderContextMenu` receives as `context.data` with this element as `context.source`: enough
to offer "Insert row above" or "Delete columns" and call the methods above.

Drag the right edge of a column header to resize the column, or double-click it to fit the column to its content.
The new width is written to `columns` and reported by `column-resize`.

Cells take a style, in `styles` or through `setStyle()`: one of eight named text and background colours, a smaller
or larger size, and bold (Ctrl/⌘+B toggles it on the selection). Styles move with their cells when rows and
columns are inserted, deleted, cut or pasted, and undo with the inputs. A user's change is reported by `style-change`.

With `rename-columns`, double-clicking a column header names the column in place, and `renameColumn()` does the same
from a menu or a button: Enter or leaving the field saves the name, Escape cancels, and Tab saves it and goes on to
the next column. The name is written to `columns` as the column's `label` and reported by `column-rename`.

members.name: data
members.description:
Raw inputs, row by row: numbers, booleans, text, or formulas as strings starting with `=`. JSON in markup.
Edits write a new array here, so it always holds the current inputs.

members.name: rows
members.description: Number of rows. Grows to fit `data`, a paste past the last row and `insertRows`.

members.name: columns
members.description:
Number of columns, or one options object per column (`label`, `width`, `format`, `align`, `resizable`, `minWidth`). JSON
in markup. Grows to fit `data`, a paste past the last column and `insertColumns`. Resizing a column writes a new
array here with its `width`.

members.name: resizable
members.description:
Lets the user drag a column header's edge to resize the column, and double-click it to fit the content. On by
default; `resizable="false"` turns it off. A column's own `resizable` still wins.

members.name: renameColumns
members.description: Lets the user name a column by double-clicking its header. `renameColumn()` works without it.

members.name: formulaBar
members.description: Shows the current cell's address and raw input above the grid. The formula bar is editable.

members.name: summary
members.description: Shows Sum, Average and Count of the selected cells below the grid.

members.name: readonly
members.description: Selection and copy work; editing, paste, cut and delete do not.

members.name: label
members.description: Accessible name of the grid.

members.name: locale
members.description: Locale for number and currency display. Defaults to the browser's. Formulas always use `,` between arguments.

members.name: currency
members.description: ISO currency code for the `currency` format and for amounts typed with `$`.

members.name: functions
members.description: Extra formula functions, keyed by name: `{ TAX: ([amount]) => … }`. Names are case-insensitive.

members.name: renaming
members.description: The column whose name is being edited in its header, and the text typed so far.

members.name: caret
members.description: Where the caret is in the formula being typed, for the suggestions and the argument hint.

members.name: helpClosed
members.description: Escape closed the suggestions; typing opens them again.

members.name: showAllFunctions
members.description: The fx button asked for every function.

members.name: ownData
members.description: The array this element last wrote to `data`, so its own write is not reloaded.

members.name: cellStyles
members.description: Styles by normalised address.

members.name: ownStyles
members.description: The object this element last wrote to `styles`, so its own write is not reloaded.

members.name: pendingCaret
members.description: A caret to put in the editor once it renders, after a function or a reference went in.

members.name: pointing

type.text: { start: number; end: number; anchor: CellPosition } | null

members.description: The reference a click on the sheet put in the formula: a drag or another click replaces it.

members.name: getValue
members.description: The computed value of a cell (`'D3'`). Errors are `CellError` objects.

members.name: getInput
members.description: The raw input of a cell, `''` when it is empty.

members.name: setInput
members.description: Writes one cell and recalculates. The change goes into the undo history but fires no event.

members.name: select
members.description: Selects `'A1'` or `'A1:C4'` and scrolls it into view. The first cell becomes the current cell.

members.name: selection
members.description: The selected range, such as `B1:E5`.

members.name: toCSV
members.description: Computed values of the used cells as comma-separated text.

members.name: toTSV
members.description: Computed values of the used cells as tab-separated text, as the clipboard holds them.

members.name: getStyle
members.description: The style of a cell (`'D3'`), `undefined` when it has none.

members.name: setStyle
members.description:
Restyles every cell of `'A1'` or `'A1:C4'`: each field of `change` sets that part of the style, `null` removes it
(as do `size: 'normal'` and `bold: false`), and the parts it leaves out stay. The change goes into the undo
history but fires no event.

members.name: undo
members.description: Reverts the last change.

members.name: redo
members.description: Re-applies the last undone change.

members.name: insertRows
members.description:
Inserts `count` empty rows before the zero-based row `index`: `0` adds them at the top, `rows` at the bottom.
The rows below move down and every formula follows the cells it reads, so `=SUM(B1:B5)` becomes `=SUM(B1:B6)`
when a row goes in inside the range. Writes `data` and `rows`, clears the undo history and fires no event.

members.name: insertColumns
members.description:
Inserts `count` empty columns before the zero-based column `index`: `0` adds them first, the column count last.
The columns to the right move over with their options (`label`, `width`, `format`, `align`), and every formula
follows the cells it reads. Writes `data` and `columns`, clears the undo history and fires no event.

members.name: deleteRows
members.description:
Deletes `count` rows from the zero-based row `index`. The rows below move up and formulas follow them: a
reference to a deleted cell becomes `#REF!` and a range that loses rows shrinks (`=SUM(B1:B5)` becomes
`=SUM(B1:B4)`). At least one row always stays. Writes `data` and `rows`, clears the undo history and fires no event.

members.name: deleteColumns
members.description:
Deletes `count` columns from the zero-based column `index`, with their options. The columns to the right move
over and formulas follow them, as `deleteRows` describes. At least one column always stays. Writes `data` and
`columns`, clears the undo history and fires no event.

members.name: insertTotal
members.description:
Writes a total of `range` (the selection when left out) as a formula, as the totals bar's buttons do: under each
column of a range taller than one row (`=SUM(C1:C4)` in C5), or after a one-row range. A row or column is inserted
first when that place is taken or past the sheet. Returns the cells written, `''` for a single cell. Fires no event.

members.name: renameColumn
members.description:
Opens the name of the zero-based column `index` for editing, in its header: Enter or leaving the field saves it,
Escape cancels, Tab saves it and goes on to the next column. Does nothing on a read-only sheet.

members.name: focus
members.description: Focuses the grid on its current cell, ready for the arrow keys and typing.

members.name: totalTargets

type.text: { key: string; range: string; position: CellPosition }[]

members.description: Where the totals of a range go: under each column of a taller range, after a one-row range.

members.name: suggestions
members.description: The functions whose name starts with the one typed at the caret; every function after `=` or from fx.

members.name: renderHelp
members.description: The suggestions, or else the hint for the call the caret is in with the formula's result so far.

members.name: renderSignature
members.description: `SUM(value1, [value2, …])` with the argument the caret is on in bold; past the last, a repeating one stays bold.

members.name: previewText
members.description: The formula's result so far, its parentheses closed; nothing while it is incomplete or an error.

members.name: insertFunction
members.description: Puts `NAME(` in place of the name typed at the caret.

members.name: onFxClick
members.description: fx: every function, for the current cell. A cell without a formula starts one.

members.name: referencedCells
members.description: Cells read by the formula being edited, each with its reference colour (1 to 4).

members.name: userSelect
members.description: Moves the selection as the user asked, and fires `selection-change` when it changed.

members.name: onEditorCaret
members.description: The caret moved without typing (arrows, a click in the text).

members.name: resizeSheet
members.description: Sets the size now rather than at the next update, so the writes that follow land inside the sheet.

members.name: restructure
members.description: Inserts or deletes rows or columns, moving every cell after them and rewriting the formulas that read them.

members.name: applyChanges
members.description: Writes inputs and recalculates. Returns whether anything changed.

members.name: applyStyles

type.text: { record: boolean; notify: boolean; join?: boolean }

members.description:
Writes styles. With `join`, the change goes into the last undo step (a paste's styles undo with its values).
Returns whether anything changed.

members.name: replay
members.description: Undoes or redoes a step: its inputs, then its styles.

members.name: restyle
members.description: Applies a style change to every cell of a range.

members.name: toggleBold
members.description: Ctrl/⌘+B: bold on, unless every selected cell is bold already.

members.name: clearSelection
members.description: Empties the selected cells, keeping their styles (as Delete does in Sheets). Returns whether anything changed.

members.name: serialise
members.description: The inputs as `data` holds them: trailing empty rows and cells trimmed, plain numbers and booleans typed.

members.name: exportRows
members.description: Computed values of the used range as text, row by row.

type.text: CellPosition | 'corner' | { row: number } | { column: number } | undefined

members.name: onContextMenuRequest
members.description:
An enclosing `c2-context-menu` asks what was right-clicked. Outside the selection, the click selects what it
landed on first, as in Sheets and Excel; the keyboard's context-menu key keeps the selection.

members.name: pointAt
members.description: Writes the cell or range from `anchor` to `extent` at the caret, in place of the one pointed at before.

members.name: commitRename
members.description: Writes the name being edited to `columns` and reports it, when it changed.

members.name: fitColumn
members.description: Fits a column to its widest header or cell, as a double-click on the edge does in Sheets and Excel.

members.name: writeColumnWidth
members.description: Writes a new `columns` array with the column's width, as edits write `data`.

events.name: selection-change
events.description: Fired after the user moves the selection. `detail.range` is the selected range and `detail.active` the current cell. Does not bubble: several components fire `selection-change`, so a listener belongs on the element itself.

events.name: cell-change
events.description: Fired once per edit, paste, cut, delete, undo or redo with every cell the user changed (`detail.changes`: `ref`, `input`, `value`, `previous`). Cells that only recalculated are not listed.

events.name: input
events.description: Fired with every `cell-change`, for generic two-way bindings.

events.name: change
events.description: Fired with every `cell-change`, for generic two-way bindings.

events.name: style-change
events.description: Fired when the user restyles cells (Ctrl/⌘+B, a paste or a cut, undo or redo) with every cell whose style changed (`detail.changes`: `ref`, `style`, `previous`). `setStyle()` fires none.

events.name: column-rename
events.description: Fired when the user saves a new name for a column. `detail.column` is the letter, `detail.index` the zero-based index, `detail.label` the new name (`''` when cleared) and `detail.previous` the old one. The name is also written to `columns`.

events.name: column-resize
events.description: Fired when the user releases a column's resize handle or double-clicks it to fit the content. `detail.column` is the letter, `detail.index` the zero-based index and `detail.width` the new width in pixels, which is also written to `columns`.
